question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 G 组：新西兰 vs 埃及（2026-06-21，90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group G: New Zealand vs Egypt (2026-06-21, 90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: 埃及凭借萨拉赫领衔的整体实力与约134分的Elo优势占上风（约53.5%），但新西兰阵容齐整、伍德复出，平局加爆冷合计概率接近一半。
one_liner_en: Egypt hold the edge (~53.5%) on a ~134-point Elo gap and a Salah-led attack, but with New Zealand at full strength and Wood back fit, draw-plus-upset probability is close to half.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 134 分（埃及 1696 vs 新西兰 1562），Davidson 模型基线给埃及约 51.6% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: 134-point Elo gap (Egypt 1696 vs New Zealand 1562); the Davidson baseline gives Egypt ~51.6%.

key_reasons.cn: 萨拉赫腿筋伤愈后出任队长，与曼城前锋马尔穆什领衔锋线；埃及 6 月 6 日仅 1-2 小负巴西，状态可用。
key_reasons.en: Salah, recovered from a hamstring injury, captains the side alongside Man City's Marmoush; Egypt lost only 1-2 to Brazil on June 6, showing serviceable form.

key_reasons.cn: 新西兰队长伍德 12 月膝伤手术后宣称完全恢复，但 34 岁且术后回归时间短，国际强度下锐度存疑。
key_reasons.en: New Zealand captain Chris Wood declares himself fully fit after December knee surgery, but at 34 with a short run-in, his sharpness at international intensity is uncertain.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net snapshot (2026-06-11) fed into Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) giving p_stat 23.9/24.6/51.6; bounded evidence adjustment of ~3.8pp total (cap 8pp) toward Egypt for attacking quality and form, renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and thin pre-opener evidence. No betting or prediction-market data consulted.
